variant: mobilenetv2-full-image-set-Adam (TF-Hub feature vector + dense head), converted to TFLite float16 (FLOAT32 I/O)
_comment_normalization: Reproduces the upstream app.py preprocessing: img/255.0 -> [0,1]. NormalizeOp computes (x-mean)/std, so mean=0,std=255 yields x/255. This is the TF-Hub MobileNetV2 feature-vector input convention. (FLOAT32 path; float16 quantization keeps the input/output tensors FLOAT32.)
_comment_tta_0012: PLANTPOTTING-0012 Phase 7 — grid-tiling TTA sweep (base 6 vs +2x2 grid vs +2x2+3x3 grid; gated pipeline; evidence: docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0012/tta-sweep-decision.md). 2x2 left clean confident-wrong flat (0.117) with slightly worse top-1; 2x2+3x3 cut confident-wrong to 0.050 only by crashing top-1 (0.417->0.317) + abstaining 63%, and busted the ~2s worst-case cap (2686ms). Grid tiles are out-of-distribution for this whole-image classifier (a 3x3 tile is ~one leaf) so they dilute confidence rather than add signal. tta stays 6; the pothos<->Pilea gate (not TTA) fixes the boundary.
_comment_preprocessing: PLANTPOTTING-0011 Phase 2 (evidence: docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0011/preprocessing-decision.md; 41-fixture/30-species eval set). center_crop measured IDENTICAL to squash (no benefit) -> DROPPED, mode stays 'squash'. Multi-crop TTA ADOPTED at 6 views (centre + 4 corners + full-frame): confident-wrong 0.382 -> 0.226 at ~6x latency (20->125ms median) on a one-shot identify. Default tta=1 (off) for any other model; only this production model is locked to 6.
_comment_thresholds: Identical to AIY (PLANTPOTTING-0003 §4.3) EXCEPT high_confidence_abstain_margin=0.30, added in PLANTPOTTING-0011 Phase 3: a high-confidence verdict whose top1-top2 margin is < 0.30 is downgraded to the picker. Tuned on the locked tta6 pipeline (evidence: docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0011/abstention-before-after.md). With TTA-6 it cuts confident-wrong 0.382->0.179 overall and 0.268->0.098 on clean photos, for an accepted pick-manually rise to ~0.323. Held-out (tune-on-clean/eval-on-perturbation) cw=0.186; leave-one-species-out 0.167-0.188 stable. Do NOT lower the plain/margin gates to flatter a candidate (0006 discipline).
_comment_per_species_thresholds: Empty by design until evidence shows an override is warranted; never seed to bless a weak prediction (0006 discipline). PLANTPOTTING-0013: pilea-peperomioides=0.98 is the elevated direct-card bar that lets a top-1=Pilea result yield a DIRECT Pilea care card instead of routing to the picker, but ONLY when it clears 0.98 — composed WITH the boundary_pairs gate (ModelScoreMapper falls through to the high-conf path only above this bar). Set strictly above the documented pothos->Pilea ceiling of 0.9661 (CI-bound > 0.9661 by HousePlantClassMapValidationTest.pileaDirectCardThresholdMustExceedPothosCeiling), so a pothos misread as Pilea @ 0.9661 can NEVER reach a direct Pilea card. On the shipped tta6 pipeline the pothos->Pilea ceiling is 0.9063 and the real-Pilea floor is 0.9940 (gap +0.0877); LOO + author-separation over the 6 Pilea fixtures = +0 confident-wrong on every fold. Evidence: docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0013/pilea-direct-card-decision.md.
_comment_boundary_pairs: PLANTPOTTING-0012 Phase 4 — pothos<->Pilea disambiguation gate (Candidate B; see docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0012/boundary-gating-decision.md). The production model confidently confuses pothos with Pilea (pothos top-1 = 'Chinese Money Plant (Pilea peperomioides)' @ 0.9661, NO second-place mass, so high_confidence_abstain_margin cannot catch it). When a result's raw top-1 resolves to pilea-peperomioides, ModelScoreMapper forces the LowConfidencePicker and surfaces BOTH pilea-peperomioides and epipremnum-aureum as candidates. Scoped to top-1 = Pilea, so a correct pothos-dominant (top-1 = pothos) result is never affected — correct, confident, direct pothos cards are preserved. This gate is the precondition for mapping Pilea at all (CI-bound by HousePlantClassMapValidationTest.pileaMappingRequiresBoundaryGate); the mapping and this block must land/stay together.
_comment_coverage: RECOMPUTE in Phase 4 from the model's actual 47 labels: 10 of 47 mapping entries resolve to KB species; 10 of 16 KB species covered (8 exact + 2 coarse: Orchid->phalaenopsis, Calathea->goeppertia-orbifolia). Headline coverage delta vs AIY: 2/16 -> 10/16. 6 KB species remain out-of-vocab (monstera-adansonii, philodendron-hederaceum, philodendron-pink-princess, ficus-lyrata, chlorophytum-comosum, hoya-carnosa) and route to LowConfidencePicker as before.
